name: cache-keepwarm
description: Protect cached context — Warm main-chat background waits invisibly and waiting sub-agents with short real turns, under independent rewrite-saving budgets.

enabled.title: Keep tracked waits warm
enabled.description: Warm only qualifying main-chat background waits. The launch default; /keepwarm on or off overrides it for this session.

minContext.title: Minimum context tokens
minContext.description: Do not warm a smaller context; its rewrite is cheap.

maxWaitMinutes.title: Waiting-item lease in minutes
maxWaitMinutes.description: Stop counting an item as a reason to warm after this many minutes pending; its liveness remains unknown.

logDir.title: Decision log directory
logDir.description: Optional directory for bounded metadata-only session JSONL logs; empty disables disk logging.

band.title: Show the row above the prompt
band.description: Show cache state, wait reason, savings ledger and the session-local keepwarm toggle. Hiding it does not disable warming.

subagents.title: Warm waiting sub-agents
subagents.description: Opt in to real warm turns for waiting sub-agents with attributable pending work. Each warm may also wake its parent and incur a separate, unbudgeted parent request.
